bookingCancellation.title: Booking & Cancellation Policy
bookingCancellation.text: A $50 deposit is required to confirm your booking. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before your scheduled appointment will result in a non-refundable deposit. No-shows will be charged the full session amount.

privacy.note: Nafa Wellness does not yet have a custom Privacy Policy. This page currently explains, in plain terms, what happens with client information (appointments, forms, and health information are handled inside Noterro; the public website itself does not collect medical information). A full policy should be reviewed and confirmed by Aminata before launch.
